### ✨ CrimsonHeart2 (v1.3.5)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Enable God Preset** — Turns on God Mode, Inf MP, No CD, 100% Crit & Inf Gold
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Zero incoming damage, evade hits & lock full HP
- **Defense Multiplier** — Multiplies P.Def/M.Def & divides incoming damage
- **One-Hit Kill** — All player & partner attacks deal 9,999,999 damage
- **100% Critical & Never Miss** — Forces every attack to land as a critical hit
- **Final Damage Multiplier** — Scales final outgoing hit damage to enemies
- **P.Atk & M.Atk Stat Multiplier** — Multiplies character physical & magical attack stats
- **Infinite MP** — Locks player & partner MP at maximum
- **No Skill Cooldown** — Skills have 0s cooldown for instant recasting
- **Full Heal HP/MP & Reset Cooldowns** — Instantly restores main & sub avatar HP/MP & skills
- **Infinite Skill Points** — Upgrading skills costs 0 Skill Points
- **EXP Gain Multiplier** — Multiplies all monster & quest EXP rewards
- **Grant +500,000 EXP** — Instantly adds 500,000 EXP to your active characters
- **+100 Stat Points & +50 Skill Points** — Safely writes bonus points into chUserAvatarData
- **+200 All Base Stats (STR/DEX/INT/VIT)** — Permanently boosts base stats on active character
- **Infinite Gold & Crystals** — Gold and Crystals/Ancient Coins never decrease
- **Infinite Bag Items & Potions** — Consumables, scrolls & materials never decrease
- **Add +10,000,000 Gold** — Calls chUserData::addGold (+10M, max 999,999,999)
- **Add +100,000 Crystals / Ancient Coins** — Calls chUserData::addCrystal (+100K, max 999,999,999)
- **Weak Enemies (1 ATK / 0 DEF)** — Monsters have 0 defense and cannot hurt you
- **Freeze Enemy HP (Practice Mode)** — Locks monster HP so you can test combos freely
- **Check Avatar & Currency Status** — Reads decrypted HP, MP, Lv, Gold & Crystals

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
